title: Motion-source ingestion and movement gaps
plainLanguage: Outside motion libraries can help when our mannequin videos do not contain a useful movement, but their body proportions and skeletons should not become our standard.
purpose: Use external motion to fill gaps without polluting the core anatomical authority.

rules.statement: External motion enters as a source adapter with exact provenance and licensing.
Retarget movement into the universal skeleton/body-family context only through an explicit conversion and review step.
Prefer small selected motion gaps over bulk ingestion.
Do not redistribute external motion data in forms prohibited by its terms.

implementation.currentSupport: External motion ingestion is not part of Corpus Pane Checkpoint 01.
implementation.futureWork: Use only after perspective/attachment foundations are stronger.
